name: Realtime / collaborative app
tagline: Next.js + Supabase — live data on a free tier
why: When features must update live across clients, Supabase bundles the database, subscriptions, and auth into one service with a generous free tier.
tradeoffs: Vendor coupling to Supabase; migrating off later is real work.
avoid_when: No realtime requirement — the plain SaaS standards are simpler.

build_order.title: Scaffold the app
build_order.description: Next.js app connected to a Supabase project, booting with a health check.

build_order.title: Model the data
build_order.description: Postgres tables with row-level security for the core entities.

build_order.title: Add accounts
build_order.description: Supabase Auth sign-up and sign-in guarding the app pages.

build_order.title: Build the core features
build_order.description: The must-have features reading and writing real data.

build_order.title: Make it live
build_order.description: Realtime subscriptions so changes appear across clients instantly.

build_order.title: Polish and harden
build_order.description: Notifications, uploads, error states, and green end-to-end tests.

testing_defaults.tiers: test-first business logic; integration tests for realtime flows

philosophy_fit: Moderate: free-first yes, local-first no (cloud service at the core).
